outcome: Children's need for extra medical resources
Children's need for extra psychosocial resources
Adherence to Child Healthcare Services (CHS) programme
Reports of concerns to social services
cohort: A cohort of 127 children (51% girls) whose mothers were referred to the Maternity and Child Healthcare Resource Team in Sweden between 2009 and 2015 due to addiction problems during pregnancy.
finding: More than three-quarters (76%) of children born to women with addiction problems during pregnancy had prenatal exposure to alcohol and drugs, with 17% experiencing withdrawal symptoms, indicating a high risk of developmental problems and a need for additional healthcare resources.
